discipline_just_cause_001.evidence: All teachers shall be guaranteed due process and no disciplinary action shall be taken without just cause.

discipline_dismissal_002.evidence: 5. Termination - In those situations where the progressive disciplinary steps have not resulted in modification of the identified behavior, or where the employee commits a serious infraction, the employee may be terminated from employment. A termination must be made by recommendation of the Superintendent to the Board.
